intuition: Count paths to each open cell by adding paths from above and from the left.

brute_force.approach: Recursively explore every right-and-down move unless a cell is blocked.

optimal.approach: Use one DP row, clearing a cell at obstacles and accumulating paths from the left.

edge_cases: A blocked start or destination yields zero paths.
A single open cell has one path.
Obstacles reset the path count for all routes through that position.
